title: A Day at the Market (יום בשוק)
text: On Fridays my mother and I go to the market. We buy fresh vegetables, fruit and bread. The market is busy and noisy, but the food is cheaper than in the shop. We always stop for a coffee before we go home.

questions.question: When do they go to the market?
Why do they like the market?

title: Learning to Swim (ללמוד לשחות)
text: When I was young, I was afraid of water. Last summer I decided to take swimming lessons. At first it was hard and I felt nervous, but my teacher was patient. Now I can swim well and I love going to the pool.

questions.question: What was the writer afraid of?

title: A New Phone (טלפון חדש)
text: Last week I bought a new phone. My old phone was slow and the battery was bad. The new one is faster and takes great photos. It was expensive, but I think it was a good choice.

questions.question: Why did the writer buy a new phone?
What does the new phone do well?

title: Weekend Plans (תוכניות לסוף השבוע)
text: This weekend my friends and I are going to the beach. We will bring food and play music. If the weather is good, we will stay until the evening. I really hope it does not rain.

title: My Grandmother's Recipe (המתכון של סבתא)
text: My grandmother makes the best soup. She learned the recipe from her mother. Every winter she invites the whole family for dinner. She says the secret is to cook it slowly and add a lot of love.

questions.question: Who did the grandmother learn the recipe from?
What is the 'secret' of the soup?
